geometry_edits: Rebuilt the structural shell from official Purdue campus GIS feature 249 while preserving the existing object, collection, scene, asset ID and file path.
Added a centered paired-glass entrance, limestone side jambs, a broad lintel and a shallow limestone plaque, guided by the official Purdue Events exterior photo.
Removed first-floor windows from the approximate entrance bay to avoid overlap; the entrance location and dimensions remain approximate.
uncertainties: The official campus polygon is not a certified survey and publishes no positional or dimensional uncertainty.
The modeled 12 m height is estimated from the GIS three-level attribute; no measured elevation source was located.
The official exterior image confirms material and entrance features but does not provide elevations or measured facade geometry.
Window spacing and entrance placement remain approximate and need independent visual review.

findings: 12 m height is estimated from the three-level GIS attribute; the source Extrution value has no documented units.
Facade and roof dimensions remain approximate; official GIS is not survey-grade.
